shellCommands.command: git status --short && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100
for f in app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx app/product/page.tsx lib/data.ts next.config.ts; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; git diff package.json
ls node_modules/.bin/next >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo installed || npm install --no-audit --no-fund 2>&1 | tail -3; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -30
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -15; git status --short
git checkout -- tsconfig.json && rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts && git status --short && git diff app/product/page.tsx
